roles.name: Shopper
goals: Find a product by name or brand in a few seconds.
See why a product qualifies (its certification) and list its ingredients.
Save a product and come back to it later on the Saved page.

workflows.name: Search for Product

steps.action: Enter search term in the search box
steps.result: Navigates to Search screen with results
Displays matching products or no-results message

workflows.success: User sees relevant product results or a clear no-results message

workflows.name: View Product Details

steps.action: Tap on a product to view details

steps.result: Sees name, brand, category, certification, ingredients and Save button

workflows.success: User sees complete product information including certification and ingredients

workflows.name: Save Product

steps.result: If signed in, product is saved; if not signed in, prompted to sign in

workflows.success: Product is saved to user's Saved list or sign-in prompt appears

workflows.name: View Saved Products

steps.result: Sees saved products by name and brand, each opening its Product page

workflows.success: User sees all saved products and can access them via their product pages
